newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean industrials firmer on giants' gains.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean industrials firmer on giants' gains.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial index closed firmer on Monday, buoyed by gains in a number of heavy-weight counters.
But brokers said the equities still looked weak in comparison with the local money market, which had lured away investors with the attraction of higher interest rates.
"The stock market is still suffering from the effects of an upward trend in infation and interest rates. We are generally still looking for direction which is sustained," commented one broker.

On Monday, the index gained 77.87 points to close at 10,140.18, feeding on gains in bankers Barclays, up 200 cents to 3,200 while another banker NMB put on 50 cents to 3,200, cement firm Porthold were up 25 cents to 1,875 and tobacco company TSL added 15 cents to 640.
Blue chip conglomerate Delta, finance house udc and horticulture group Ariston all went up 10 cents to 1,710, 250 and 180 respectively.

Trade in minings picked up considerably with nickel producer Bindura and coal miners Wankie trading at previous levels while gold firm Falgold added five cents to 75 and Rio Tinto, another gold producer, surge 250 cents to 2,300. The index shrugged off a five cent loss to 25 in copper company Mhangura, closing 27.54 points firmer at 990.88.
